input.content:
I understand, Mei. Just to clarify how exchanges work: an exchange on a delivered order can only swap an item for a different variant of the same product (for example, the same Office Chair but in a different color, material, or backrest height). It isn't possible to exchange for the exact same item/variant — so I couldn't exchange your blue leather high-back chair (no armrest) for that identical item.

Here are your options:
1. Exchange the Office Chair for a different variant of the same chair (I can check which variants are available).
2. Proceed with the return as we discussed, with the refund to your Mastercard ending in 1037.

Which would you like to do?
